rows.Kwic: 此偈此簡，皆肆口而說，肆筆而書，曾不經意，深足以發明言外之旨。彼膠於情識者，方以雕蟲篆刻為事，

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Liao'an Qingyu (了菴清欲禪師語錄), volume nine, inscription on writings by Biefeng and Tudu. Liao'an Qingyu is the author and exact speaker of the inscription; he contrasts their uncontrived verse and letters with people glued to discriminating consciousness who busy themselves with literary carving.
